Search with md followed by a filename or text. Use md alone to list up to 100 notes. Press Return to open a result.
Setup on another Mac: 1. Install Python 3 using Alfred’s official instructions: https://www.alfredapp.com/help/kb/install-dependencies/ No pip packages are required. Homebrew on Intel and Apple Silicon, python.org installations in /usr/local/bin, and working Apple developer-tools Python are detected. 2. In workflow configuration, set Notes folder if your vault is elsewhere. The default uses your current home folder and the Obsidian vault named csaborio. 3. In Finder, download the iCloud vault (Keep Downloaded where available).
Search checks filenames and relative paths first, then note content if no names match. Content scans stop after five seconds with a visible message if files are slow to read. Hidden folders are skipped. Folder::query syntax is not supported.
Folder containing your Markdown notes. Use ~ for the current Mac user’s home folder.
